title: a field whose project pattern would match a line break is still refused: the control character ban holds for every field
source: intended: docs/decisions.md, Pre-release fixes (the fields reach brief.md)
intent: The field values are written one per line into brief.md, so no value may hold a line break. The ban on control characters is part of the value check of every field, not only of a field without a pattern: a project pattern that would match a newline (`(?s).+`) does not lift it. The launch is rejected and writes nothing.

stderr.contains: JITSO REJECTED: field note has an invalid value
